Group 1-placed at Munich last July, he has won four times in Poland and once in Germany and was placed at Group 3 and 2 levels respectively only last October. He made his Irish debut at Cork wearing a tongue-tie and while well held, performed to a useful level from a rating of 108. Grey Fable has a hurdle rating of 109 and has scored twice on the Flat, albeit at a much lower level. He showed ability at Gowran last October but will struggle to beat an on-song selection. Romany Brown is consistent and also makes the shortlist.

Kortez Bay ran a cracker when second under a big weight in the Irish Lincolnshire, but probably needs soft ground to be seen at his best.

selections.comment: A progressive handicapper last season, CLOUD SEEKER can register his first success of the new campaign. The Andrew Slattery-trained gelding took a few runs before getting his head in front last term, so should be all the better for a recent reappearance at Tipperary. Dropped 1lb for that outing, the four-year-old could be capable of further improvement. A course winner who is adaptable in terms of trip, he will almost certainly be ridden prominently over this 10 furlongs. A dual winner over this sort of distance last year, Masoun is another who should come on from a recent run and Joseph O'Brien's son of Too Darn Hot will appreciate stepping back up in distance. Navan maiden winner Sidiza also merits consideration.

However, there was plenty to like about his recent reappearance when a staying-on third back at the Curragh. Navan second Palmezzano has strong claims of going one better and Joseph O'Brien's gelded son of Saxon Warrior wouldn't have to improve much to win. Dundalk scorer Drucker shouldn't be ruled out back on turf.

After being outstayed over further than 3m, she can make amends dropped back in distance.

selections.comment: Quite a lot of these appear to be on stiff marks based on their recent efforts. One that is in form is Ninth Life having seemingly retained his ability after a year off as illustrated by a good third at Chelmsford last time. Preference though is for a likely improver in MIGHTY QUEST. She scored convincingly on her final start of 2024 on soft ground at Bath. The suspicion is that a sound surface will suit even better and that she is just beginning her upward curve. Free Speech isn't badly handicapped on two wins last summer and probably needed the run on her reappearance. She should come on for that run and can go well.

The former has been the subject of some questionable rides but ran a big race to place on his return from a break last time in a race which has worked out well. Turnip Gold returns from a long absence off a potentially generous mark and is also worth following in the betting for a yard back among the winners.

A 3 time winner over hurdles she is unexposed as a stayer and will be tough to peg back here if her jumping holds up. The handicapper is catching up with the prolific Camino Rocio but he could still complete the tricast.

His yard loves a winner here and he could get another if his charge builds on that reappearance.
